To activate pairing mode on the bulb:

1. Turn on the bulb
2. Flick the switch 10 times quickly (on/off)
3. The bulb will start blinking (pairing mode confirmation)
4. Look for the "Sengled_Wi-Fi Bulb_XXXX" network in your WiFi

Use this when the bulb is ALREADY on your WiFi but didn't show up on its own. This can happen if:

• The card wasn't added automatically when you paired it.
• You want to use the app from ANOTHER phone and the bulb is already on your network.

Enter the bulb IP (you can see it in your router). If you also enter the MAC, the app can find the bulb by itself again when the IP changes.
Controls your Sengled W21-N11 bulbs directly over your local network (WiFi), no external servers needed. Communicates via UDP to turn on, off, and adjust brightness.

Schedule on/off times for each bulb. When your phone connects to WiFi, the app executes actions automatically.\n\nImportant: for routines to work, the app must stay alive in the background. Make sure to disable battery optimization for this app and allow background execution; otherwise the system may close it and routines will not run. Notifications must also be enabled.
Add each bulb\'s IP and MAC as a static IP in your router. This way the bulb keeps the same address and the app never loses connection.
Sengled W21-N11 bulbs only work on 2.4 GHz networks.
Have a question or suggestion about this app?

If you have an improvement or new feature in mind, write me at:

fere.espiritu@gmail.com

We will review if the proposed functionality is viable.

The app is available on my GitHub repository:
https://github.com/espiritu1/sengled-local-control

⚠ This application is NOT affiliated with or official Sengled.

The Android app was independently developed. The UDP communication protocol is based on documentation from the community project HamzaETTH/SengledTools on GitHub, allowing the bulbs to work locally without relying on external servers.

https://github.com/HamzaETTH/SengledTools
Refresh — Checks the status of your bulbs
Add — Pair a new bulb or add it by IP/MAC
Delete — Removes the bulb from the app
Routine — Set on/off schedule for the bulb
Switch — Turn the bulb on or off
Reorder — Press and hold a card, then drag it up or down to change the bulb order
